name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Slow-simmered beef and tomato ragù with spaghetti. The family weeknight staple.
steps: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it. Stir in tomato paste, tomatoes and oregano.
Simmer gently for 45 minutes, adding a splash of water if needed. Season.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the sauce and Parmesan.

name: Lasagne
description: Layers of meat sauce, béchamel and pasta, baked until bubbling.
steps: Make a meat sauce: soften onion, garlic and carrot in oil, brown the mince, add passata, tomato paste and oregano and simmer 30 minutes.
Make a béchamel with butter, flour and milk; season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Layer sauce, lasagne sheets and béchamel in an oven dish, three times, finishing with béchamel and cheese.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 to 45 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Roman-style carbonara with egg, Parmesan, bacon and lots of black pepper.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water.
Fry the bacon until crisp. Whisk the eggs with the Parmesan and plenty of pepper.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of cooking water. Off the heat, toss pasta with bacon, then the egg mixture, loosening with pasta water until silky.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
description: Fiery tomato and garlic sauce with chilli. Vegetarian and ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Gently fry garlic and chilli in olive oil without browning.
Add the tomatoes, season and simmer 10 minutes while the penne cooks.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and parsley. Serve with Parmesan.

name: Pasta Pesto with Green Beans and Potato
description: Ligurian-style trofie dish made with fusilli, pesto, green beans and potato.
steps: Boil the potato cubes in salted water for 5 minutes, add the pasta, and add the beans for the last 5 minutes.
Drain, keeping a little cooking water, and toss with the pesto.
Serve with pine nuts and Parmesan.

name: Macaroni with Ham and Cheese
description: Belgian-style macaroni in a cheesy sauce with ham, baked under a golden crust.
steps: Cook the macaroni until just al dente.
Make a béchamel with butter, flour and milk; melt in 150 g of the cheese and season with nutmeg.
Mix the pasta, ham and sauce, transfer to an oven dish, top with remaining cheese and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

name: Tagliatelle with Salmon and Spinach
description: Creamy salmon pasta with spinach, lemon and dill.
steps: Cook the tagliatelle.
Fry the garlic in olive oil, add the salmon and cook 3 minutes. Add the spinach until wilted.
Stir in crème fraîche, lemon zest and juice and dill. Season and toss with the pasta.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
description: Penne, tuna, sweetcorn and tomato baked with cheese. Uses mostly store-cupboard ingredients.
steps: Cook the penne for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Soften the onion in a little oil from the tuna, add passata and oregano and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix pasta, sauce, drained tuna and sweetcorn. Top with cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy risotto with mushrooms, thyme and Parmesan.
steps: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1.2 litres of hot water and keep warm.
Fry the mushrooms in half of the butter until golden; set aside.
Soften shallot and garlic, add the rice and stir 1 minute. Add the wine, then ladle in stock gradually, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, thyme leaves, remaining butter and Parmesan. Rest 2 minutes before serving.

name: Thai Red Chicken Curry
description: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken, peppers and green beans.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste in oil for 1 minute, add the chicken and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add coconut milk, pepper and beans and simmer 10 minutes. Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Serve with rice and coriander.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Mild, creamy tomato curry with marinated chicken. A crowd pleaser for kids.
steps: Marinate the chicken in yoghurt with half the spices and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Cook the rice. Brown the chicken in half the butter; set aside.
Melt the rest of the butter, soften onion, garlic and ginger, add remaining spices and passata and simmer 10 minutes. Blend smooth.
Return the chicken, add the cream and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice and coriander.

name: Chili con Carne
description: Beef and bean chili with cumin and smoked paprika. Even better the next day.
steps: Soften onion, garlic and pepper in olive oil. Add the mince and brown well.
Add the spices and tomato paste, then the tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and 200 ml water.
Simmer 45 minutes, add the beans for the last 15 minutes. Season.
Serve with rice and a spoon of crème fraîche.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
description: Quick vegan-friendly curry of chickpeas, tomato, coconut and spinach.
steps: Cook the rice. Soften onion, garlic and ginger in oil and add the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, season with salt and lime. Serve with rice.

name: Red Lentil Dal
description: Comforting spiced red lentils with tomato and a garlic-cumin tarka.
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer with 1 litre water, turmeric and ginger for 20 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and garam masala and cook 5 minutes more. Season. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Fry onion and garlic in butter until golden, add cumin, and pour over the dal. Serve with rice and coriander.

name: Vegetable Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Egg noodles with crunchy vegetables in a soy-ginger sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and toss with sesame oil.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger in hot oil, add carrot, broccoli and pepper for 3 minutes, then pak choi and bean sprouts for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss until hot. Serve with spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Ginger Soy Chicken with Rice
description: Sticky chicken stir-fry with broccoli and a glossy soy-honey glaze.
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the chicken with the cornflour.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until golden. Add garlic, ginger and broccoli with a splash of water and cook 4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and honey and let it bubble until glossy. Serve with rice, spring onion and sesame.

name: Pad Thai with Prawns
description: Rice noodles with prawns, egg, bean sprouts and peanuts in a sweet-sour sauce.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water until just soft; drain.
Whisk fish sauce, sugar, soy sauce, juice of 1 lime and peanut butter with 3 tbsp water.
Stir-fry the garlic and prawns until pink. Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add noodles and sauce and toss.
Add bean sprouts and spring onion. Serve with lime wedges and coriander.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Leftover-rice fried rice with egg, peas and spring onion. Ten minutes flat.
ingredients: 300 g basmati rice, cooked the day before
steps: Stir-fry the carrot and garlic in hot oil for 2 minutes. Add the peas.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add the cold rice and toss over high heat for 4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with spring onion.

name: Ratatouille
description: Provençal stew of aubergine, courgette, pepper and tomato. Serve with rice, bread or as a side.
steps: Fry the aubergine in half the oil until golden; set aside.
Soften onion, garlic and peppers in the rest of the oil, then add courgette.
Add tomatoes, thyme and aubergine and simmer covered for 30 minutes. Season and finish with basil.

name: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
description: Whole roast chicken on a bed of potatoes, carrots and onions, with lemon and thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Rub the chicken with butter, salt and pepper and stuff with the halved lemon, half the garlic and thyme.
Toss the vegetables with oil, salt and remaining garlic and thyme in a roasting tin. Place the chicken on top.
Roast 1 hour 20 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes before carving.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Spiced chicken and peppers in warm wraps with guacamole and yoghurt.
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, salt and half the oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot pan until cooked; remove. Fry peppers and onion until charred at the edges.
Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
Warm the wraps and fill at the table with chicken, peppers, guacamole, yoghurt and cheese.

name: Homemade Beef Burgers
description: Juicy beef burgers with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and oven fries.
steps: Bake the fries according to the packet.
Season the mince and shape four patties. Grill or pan-fry 3 to 4 minutes per side, adding cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, gherkins and sauces.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Lamb and vegetable ragù under a crust of fluffy mashed potato.
ingredients: 800 g lamb shoulder, minced or finely diced
steps: Brown the lamb, add onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes. Stir in flour and tomato paste.
Add Worcestershire sauce, stock cube and 400 ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Add the peas.
Boil and mash the potatoes with milk and butter.
Spoon the filling into a dish, top with mash and cheese and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

name: Baked Salmon with Lemon Potatoes
description: One-tray salmon with lemony roast potatoes and green asparagus.
steps: Toss the potatoes with oil, salt and the zest of one lemon and roast at 210 °C for 20 minutes.
Add the asparagus and salmon, drizzle with oil and lay lemon slices on the fish.
Roast 12 minutes more. Finish with dill and lemon juice.

name: Cod with Mustard Sauce and Mash
description: Poached cod with a Flemish mustard cream sauce, mashed potatoes and spinach.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with milk and half of the butter.
Dissolve the stock cube in 500 ml simmering water and poach the cod for 6 minutes.
Soften the shallot in butter, add cream, mustard and a ladle of poaching liquid and reduce slightly.
Wilt the spinach and serve with the cod, mash and sauce.

name: Sea Bass with Fennel and Orange
description: Crispy-skinned sea bass on roasted fennel with orange and olives.
steps: Roast the fennel with olive oil, salt and orange zest at 200 °C for 20 minutes. Add the olives.
Prepare the couscous with boiling water and orange juice.
Fry the sea bass skin side down for 4 minutes, flip for 1 minute. Serve on the fennel with the couscous.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Mustard Cream
description: Seared pork tenderloin with a creamy mustard and mushroom sauce.
steps: Boil the potatoes and beans.
Season the tenderloin, sear on all sides in butter and roast at 180 °C for 15 minutes. Rest.
Fry the mushrooms and shallot in the same pan, add cream and mustard and simmer 3 minutes.
Slice the pork and serve with the sauce, potatoes and beans.

name: Sausage and Vegetable Traybake
description: Sausages roasted with sweet potato, red onion, pepper and rosemary on one tray.
steps: Toss the vegetables with oil, rosemary, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Nestle in the sausages and roast at 200 °C for 40 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with mustard.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Peppers filled with spiced mince, rice and tomato, baked under cheese.
steps: Cook the rice for 8 minutes; drain. Cut the tops off the peppers and remove seeds.
Brown the mince with onion, garlic and spices. Mix with the rice and half the passata.
Fill the peppers, stand them in a dish with the rest of the passata, top with cheese and bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.

name: Moroccan Chicken with Couscous
description: Cumin and cinnamon chicken thighs with apricots, chickpeas and fluffy couscous.
steps: Brown the chicken in olive oil; remove. Soften onion and garlic and add the spices.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas, apricots, stock cube and 300 ml water. Return the chicken and simmer covered 30 minutes.
Prepare the couscous with boiling water and a pinch of salt. Serve with coriander.

name: Black Bean Tacos
description: Smoky black beans and corn in soft wraps with avocado, feta and lime.
steps: Fry the onion in oil, add the spices, beans and corn and warm through, lightly crushing some of the beans.
Warm the wraps in a dry pan.
Fill with the beans, avocado, feta and coriander and squeeze over lime.

name: Orzo with Prawns, Tomato and Feta
description: One-pot orzo cooked in tomato with prawns, finished with feta and herbs.
steps: Fry the garlic in olive oil, add orzo, passata, cherry tomatoes, stock cube and 500 ml water.
Simmer 10 to 12 minutes, stirring, until the orzo is tender. Add the prawns for the last 3 minutes.
Crumble over the feta, add parsley and lemon zest and serve.

name: Coconut Prawn Curry
description: Mild Kerala-style prawn curry with coconut, tomato and lime.
steps: Cook the rice. Soften onion, garlic, ginger and chilli in oil and add the spices.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook 3 minutes until pink. Season with lime and salt.

name: Slow-Cooked Lamb Tagine
description: Spiced lamb shoulder with prunes, almonds and couscous. Weekend project.
steps: Brown the lamb in batches in olive oil. Soften the onions and garlic and add the spices.
Return the lamb, add tomatoes, stock cube, honey and 500 ml water. Cover and cook in the oven at 160 °C for 2 hours.
Add the prunes for the last 30 minutes. Toast the almonds.
Serve with couscous, almonds and coriander.

name: Quiche Lorraine
description: Classic quiche with bacon, Gruyère and a silky egg custard.
steps: Line a tart tin with the pastry and blind-bake at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Fry the bacon and scatter over the base with the cheese.
Whisk eggs, cream, milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper and pour in.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes until just set. Serve with a green salad.

name: Chicken and Leek Pie
description: Creamy chicken, leek and mushroom filling under a puff pastry lid.
steps: Brown the chicken in butter, add leeks and mushrooms and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then 300 ml water with the stock cube. Simmer 10 minutes, add crème fraîche and mustard. Season and cool slightly.
Pour into a pie dish, cover with pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

name: Steak with Pepper Sauce and Fries
description: Steak-frites with a creamy peppercorn sauce and a simple salad.
steps: Bake the fries. Bring the steaks to room temperature and season with salt.
Sear the steaks in hot butter, 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest.
In the same pan soften the shallot, add pepper, crumbled stock cube and cream and reduce until thick.
Serve the steaks with sauce, fries and a lettuce-tomato salad.

name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
description: Marinated chicken skewers with peanut sauce, rice and cucumber salad.
steps: Marinate the chicken in 2 tbsp soy sauce, curry powder and honey for 15 minutes. Thread onto skewers.
Warm peanut butter, coconut milk, remaining soy, lime juice and sriracha into a smooth sauce.
Grill the skewers 4 minutes per side. Cook the rice.
Slice the cucumber and toss with vinegar. Serve everything together.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: Strips of beef and mushrooms in a paprika-sour cream sauce over tagliatelle.
ingredients: 500 g beef steaks, in thin strips
steps: Cook the pasta. Sear the beef quickly in hot butter in batches; set aside.
Fry onion and mushrooms until golden, add paprika.
Stir in crème fraîche and mustard, return the beef and warm through. Serve over the pasta with parsley.

name: Sweet Potato and Lentil Curry
description: Hearty vegan curry with sweet potato, green lentils and spinach.
steps: Cook the brown rice.
Soften the onion and garlic in oil, add the curry powder, sweet potato and lentils.
Add coconut milk, tomatoes, stock cube and 400 ml water. Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach, season and serve.

name: Pumpkin Pasta with Sage Butter
description: Roasted butternut squash folded through penne with brown butter and Parmesan.
steps: Roast the squash with olive oil, salt and pepper at 200 °C for 30 minutes. Mash half of it.
Cook the penne. Brown the butter with garlic and thyme.
Toss the pasta with mashed and cubed squash, the butter, Parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Top with walnuts.

name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
description: Glazed salmon over rice with edamame, cucumber and avocado.
steps: Cook the rice and the edamame.
Simmer soy sauce, honey, vinegar and ginger until slightly syrupy.
Pan-fry the salmon 3 minutes per side and brush with the glaze.
Build bowls of rice, salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado. Top with sesame and spring onion.

name: Fish Fingers with Mashed Peas
description: Kid-friendly dinner of baked fish fingers, minty mashed peas and potato wedges.
steps: Toss the wedges with oil and salt and roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Bake the fish fingers for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the peas, then mash with butter and mint. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Turkey Schnitzel with Potato Salad
description: Crumbed turkey escalopes with a tangy mustard potato salad.
steps: Boil the potatoes, slice and dress while warm with onion, mustard, mayonnaise and gherkins.
Dip the escalopes in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil 3 minutes per side until golden. Serve with lemon wedges and the potato salad.

name: Spaghetti with Meatballs
description: Herby beef meatballs in marinara over spaghetti.
steps: Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, half the Parmesan and seasoning. Roll into 20 balls and brown in olive oil.
Add garlic, passata and oregano and simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs, basil and remaining Parmesan.

name: Minestrone
description: Thick Italian vegetable soup with beans and small pasta. A meal in a bowl.
steps: Soften onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes, stock cubes and 1.5 litres water. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add courgette, cabbage, beans and pasta and cook 10 minutes more.
Season and serve with a spoon of pesto and Parmesan.
